create_LSUMBase_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that loads images from a text file list with configurable resize and interpolation
use_LSUMBase_getitem: use LSUNBase __getitem__ to load, center-crop, resize, and normalize an image to float32 range [-1, 1]
create_LSUNChurchesTrain_dataset: create an LSUNChurchesTrain dataset for training on church outdoor images with random horizontal flip
create_LSUNBedroomsTrain_dataset: create an LSUNBedroomsTrain dataset for training on bedroom images with random horizontal flip
create_LSUNCatsTrain_dataset: create an LSUNCatsTrain dataset for training on cat images with random horizontal flip
